description: What decides whether six of cli/cli's pull requests into trunk can merge, as rozed-bot, which can only read cli/cli, read only. trunk's classic protection, which rozed-bot sees only part of, requires an approval, a code owner's (a team rozed-bot can't see) and three build checks. #13788: the builds failed. #12942: conflicts. #14781: a draft. #13899: a maintainer requested changes. #14964: waiting on an approval. #13340: a first-time contributor's, whose workflows never ran. Added on 2026-11-08 from a later read, when the query gained them: each check suite's app (null where that read couldn't see it), the squash merge settings, and viewerCanDisableAutoMerge.
